input_fields.name: target_feature
input_fields.description: One target feature whose visibility or interpretation is unresolved.

input_fields.name: current_view
input_fields.description: Current view identity, camera/projection, and observed image region.

input_fields.name: occlusion_reason
input_fields.description: Observed occlusion/uncertainty reason and the missing evidence needed to resolve it.

result_fields.name: visual_uncertainty_record
result_fields.description: Target, current view, visible symptom, occlusion/uncertainty reason, missing view/evidence, and unresolved status.

procedure: Locate target_feature in current_view and record the visible symptom or overlap region.
Classify the observed occlusion_reason and identify the smallest missing view/evidence needed.
Return visual_uncertainty_record with status unresolved/needs_manual_review as appropriate.
Do not fill the gap by assuming the hidden feature is absent or by changing geometry.
rejection_rules: Reject an unidentifiable target/view, missing occlusion reason, or a record that asserts structure from invisibility.
Do not convert uncertainty into a failed geometry conclusion without the required evidence.
Do not hide the issue by clearing the view record.
